comments.author: Natascha
comments.body:
This book is useless for gaming purposes. Moreover, the quest chain is a hard one.

However, the costumes it makes look nice. So some show-off are ready to buy those for a lot. So the show-off providers will make some money from the book (or the show-off themselves will buy it).

As a whole, this book *might* have value, depending on how many show-offs there are vs. how many people who have the skill for the chain.
